caseName: eBay Inc. v. MercExchange, L. L. C.
caseNameFull: eBay Inc. Et Al. v. MercExchange, L. L. C.

opinions.text: C. A. Fed. Cir. Certiorari granted. In addition to the question presented by the petition, the parties are directed to brief and argue the following question: “Whether this Court should reconsider its precedents, including Continental Paper Bag Co. v. Eastern Paper Bag Co., 210 U. S. 405 (1908), on when it is appropriate *1030 to grant an injunction against a patent infringer.”
